verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents an official MCP server, platform APIs, AI that automatically syncs emails and events, and Agentforce agents shown 'Updating opportunity' across every stage of the deal cycle. Together these point to the core of the story. But no evidence shows an agent actually reading email or meeting signals and writing deal stage or next-step updates back through the API or MCP server. missing for 10: documentation of signal-driven updates to stage and next-step fields, documentation that the MCP server exposes opportunity write tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server
